_doc: Planet registry, keyed by planet id. Each planet helper adds its own entry. env = script with static apply(world, field, kind); sky/fog/sun/ambient are the preset values that env applies (sun discs come from data/solar_system.json via SolarSystem.suns_for when present); palette and junk_tint are [r, g, b(, a)]; music_mood is the key for the sound helper.
